notes: The panel now reconciles its layout with the server at startup instead of waiting to be touched: an arranged panel uploads its room assignments, tile order and tile sizes on launch, and a panel with nothing arranged - a fresh install, or one whose storage was wiped - takes the stored layout back. Whichever side actually has a layout wins; when both have one, the tablet in front of you is the authority. A corrupt blob on the server can't wipe a working layout, and the reconcile waits for the real stored preferences rather than the momentary defaults, so it can't mistake a still-loading panel for an unarranged one.
